decision_cruda.rationale: E569-08 stopped 5-8h, so LH-03 is idle and can be lent under the rules. Activating RS-N548-03 (18.4 g/t, 311 t) in Norte takes 0.72 h travel plus 1.0 h activation, so loading starts about 11:45. That leaves roughly 5 h of loading at 38.5 t/h, or about 200 t, worth about 120 oz. Norte is not truck-limited (66 t/h trucks vs 29 t/h inflow, 22/450 t stockpile). Central reserves are lower value and Central is already truck-limited, so they would add little. No development loader is taken.
